tests.name: Hook A (agency white-label) vs Hook B (individual DIY)
tests.hypothesis: An agency-outcome hook lowers prospecting cost per trial below $260 because agency trials convert to paid at ~1.8x.
tests.notes: Read after both arms clear $2,000 each.

tests.name: RSA headline v3 (pinned price claim)
tests.hypothesis: Pinning 'Replace 4 SEO tools with one' as H1 lifts non-brand CTR above 5.5%.

tests.name: Retargeting split by segment, 14-day window
tests.hypothesis: Splitting 30-day retargeting into agency and individual 14-day audiences lowers cost per trial below $220.
tests.notes: Won: $192.50 vs $220. Shipped as Retargeting_Agency_14d + Retargeting_Individual_14d on 11-01.

tests.name: Interest stack vs Advantage+ broad
tests.hypothesis: A hand-built interest stack beats Advantage+ broad on cost per trial (below $260).
tests.notes: Lost: $359 per trial. Interest stack retired; budget moved to Advantage+.

tests.name: PMax with brand exclusion
tests.hypothesis: Excluding brand terms from PMax keeps click-to-trial above 1.2% without brand cannibalisation.
tests.notes: Under min_trials (13 of 20). Rerun with a longer window.

tests.name: UK non-brand: GBP pricing landing page
tests.hypothesis: Showing GBP prices lifts UK click-to-trial above 2.0% now that the tag fires.

lessons.text: Brand search CPT ($150) is the cheapest line in the account but the least incremental; cap it, don't grow it.
Meta CTR sits at 1.0-1.2% across prospecting; creative, not audience, moves it.
Shared budget starvation: Search_NonBrand_US drained the shared Google budget and Search_Brand_US delivered ~30% of plan 09-15 to 09-19. Every campaign now carries its own budget; no shared budgets.
Interest stacks lost to Advantage+ broad ($359 vs $270 per trial). Stop hand-building interest audiences for prospecting.
Meta event break: from 09-22 Meta reports ~1/3 of the trials PostHog records. Judge Meta on PostHog trials only; never optimise to platform-reported conversions until the event is repaired.
Free-intent and informational queries ('free seo tools', 'what is seo') burned ~$1,300 with zero trials. Review search terms weekly.
PMax brand-exclusion test never reached minimum trials. Set min_trials so a 3-week test can actually clear it.
Segmented 14-day retargeting beat the 30-day pool ($192 vs $220 target). Agency visitors convert to paid at ~1.8x individuals.

UK tag fix: the UK signup tag had never fired, so Search_NonBrand_UK showed zero trials for 12 weeks. Fixed 11-02; UK trials start appearing the same day. Treat any campaign with spend and zero trials for 7 days as a tracking problem first.
New build plus legacy Meta campaigns overlap audiences; legacy click-to-trial dropped ~7% since 11-01. Watch frequency and wind legacy down once Core clears learning.
